notes.subject: ruak
notes.rationale: רוח i wanpela tok — win, win bilong het, Spirit; hia em i tok olsem nating, olsem win i wokabaut

notes.subject: skelim ol tok long ruak
notes.rationale: Ol tanim tok i no wankain: sampela i tok 'ol tok bilong man yaus em i olsem win tasol' (KJV/ASV), narapela i tok 'yupela tingting olsem tok inap luksave man' (JPS)

notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin i nidim em, Hibru i no gat

translation: Long skim stret, yupela skelim ol tok, na long ruak, ol tok bilong man i no gat larat long ⟨em⟩?

tokens.gloss: ol tok bilong man i no gat larat
man i no gat larat tru
